## About
The Paintshop Automotive is an auto body and custom paint shop on Reindeer Trail in Leon Valley, working on cars, trucks and other vehicles for drivers across the greater San Antonio area. Whether you have a few spots that need touching up or you want a completely new look, we handle it in our own paint shop.
When a hail storm leaves your car covered in dents, we repair the damage, including any touchup painting it needs. We also offer paintless dent repair, which removes dents without repainting your car. If you've been in an accident, from a minor fender bender to a serious collision, we'll work with your insurance company so your claim is filed and processed smoothly.
One reviewer said David and his crew restored her car after a stressful accident so it looked brand new. Give us a call and tell us what you have in mind.

## Services
- Auto body repair: Full body repair after an accident, whether it was a minor fender bender or a serious collision.
- Auto painting and custom paint: Traditional auto painting for your car or truck, plus custom paint jobs when you want a whole new look.
- Paintless dent repair: Dents removed without having to repaint your car, which can save you money compared with traditional dent repair.
- Hail damage repair: Repair for the dents a hail storm leaves behind, including any touchup painting that needs to be done.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help me save on my deductible?
A: The shop says it can help you save up to $500 on your deductible. Call us to find out how.

Q: Do you work on trucks too?
A: Yes. We do auto body paint and paint repair for cars, trucks and other vehicles.

Q: Why choose paintless dent repair?
A: It removes dents without repainting your car and can save you money compared with traditional dent repair techniques.
